case.pattern_description: Online purchase from a proxy desktop device inconsistent with the cardholder's typical in‑person spending, matching prior confirmed card‑not‑present fraud on the same device.

evidence.claim: Risk score of 0.90 for the flagged online transaction
Prior confirmed fraud cases (CC-5026, CC-2860, CC-2011) on same customer and device
Device is a proxy desktop, a known indicator of card‑not‑present fraud
Relevant previous investigations (AGENT-HHG-017 etc.) link this device to confirmed card‑not‑present fraud

case.summary: The flagged $99.92 online purchase scored 0.90 on the real‑time model. The card has a history of in‑person use, but the transaction originated from a proxy desktop device, matching multiple prior confirmed card‑not‑present fraud cases on the same device. Combined with a high risk score and independent fraud evidence, the fraud probability is assessed at 0.88, leading to a fraud verdict.

final.reason: High fraud probability with multiple independent fraud indicators (risk score, prior confirmed fraud on same device).
Fraud probability >= 0.30 requires case creation per policy.

next_best_actions.what_changed: Initial assessment led to fraud verdict; actions added to block the card and create a case.

sar.reason: Exposure $99.92 is below $1,000 and no coordinated or undocumented pattern, so SAR filing not required per policy.

stop_reason: Fraud probability >= 0.85 supported by two independent pieces of evidence (high risk score and prior confirmed fraud on same device).
